enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe regularly. Remain still. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Move legs. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side again. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off light. Walk out.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and pan. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Scramble eggs. Turn off stove. Put eggs on plate. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing belongings for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Select shirt and pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out belt. Put on belt. Close drawer. Walk to desk. Pick up bag. Open bag. Put in laptop. Put in phone. Close bag. Pick up keys. Walk to door.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Take out phone. Check time. Put phone away. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to clinic. Enter clinic building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional at the clinic
enriched_activities.desc: Enter clinic. Greet receptionist. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Wash hands. Walk to nurses' station. Pick up patient chart. Review patient history. Walk to exam room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Measure blood pressure. Measure temperature. Listen to heart. Listen to lungs. Prescribe medication. Write notes. Walk to next patient.

Walk out of clinic. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Take out phone. Check messages. Put phone away. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out cutting board and knife. Close cabinet. Chop vegetables. Cut meat. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Put food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from table. Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Stack plates. Pick up glasses. Carry to sink. Open dishwasher. Pull out bottom rack. Place plates in rack. Place glasses in rack. Push rack in. Open dishwasher detergent compartment. Add detergent. Close compartment. Close dishwasher. Press start button. Wipe table with cloth. Turn off kitchen light.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Pick up shampoo. Apply shampoo. Rub scalp. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Turn off light. Walk out.

Enter living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Press power button. TV turns on. Browse channels. Stop on a show. Watch TV. Put remote down. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Using phone and winding down for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open app. Scroll through feed. Read messages. Reply to message. Close app. Put phone down. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Walk back to bedroom. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Close eyes.

Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe regularly. Remain still. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Move legs. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side again. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping.
